name: @clawd/desktop
description: The desktop app: the agent and the visualiser in one window and the tray, run from a folder.

scripts.dev: node build/clean.mjs && node build/bundle.mjs && electron . --dev-url http://localhost:3000
scripts.start: node build/clean.mjs && node build/renderer.mjs && node build/bundle.mjs && electron .
scripts.package: node build/clean.mjs && node build/renderer.mjs && node build/bundle.mjs && electron-builder --win
